about: Always Open's own line: 15 business-owner calls (Brief 3, Part 7b, Nov 5, 2026). The 42-call set has only three, too few to judge a change to how Max sells. must/never are what a judge holds Max to.

turns: what does this cost
what's the difference between starter and growth
okay, I'll think about it
calls.must: the three prices plainly, the difference in a sentence

turns: what do I actually get for a hundred forty nine a month
is the phone part in that
cool, thanks
calls.must: what Starter includes, that Max comes with every plan
calls.never: a feature not on the line

turns: does the cheap plan come with online booking
can customers book themselves at night
okay good
calls.must: every plan has the booking page
calls.never: say Growth is needed for booking

turns: if I sign up and hate it, how do I get out
is there a contract
okay
calls.must: month to month, cancel in the app, first month refunded, Katie can help

turns: do you record my customers' calls
who can read them
how long do you keep them
calls.must: transcripts not audio, only the owner and Always Open, 13 months

turns: can it text my customers back
how soon does that start
thanks
calls.must: texting starts once carriers approve the number, about two weeks
calls.never: say texting works the first day

turns: I run a dental office, we have to be careful with patient info
can you book cleanings
have someone call me, Dr. Reyes, this number
calls.must: privacy first, message-only on a dental line, Katie calls back

turns: how do I know you won't say something dumb to my customers
what if someone asks you something you don't know
hm, okay
calls.must: sticks to what the business gave him, takes a message when unsure

turns: wait, is this a robot
huh. you're pretty good
so what do you do exactly
calls.must: S.I., not a person, in a few words, then the short answer

turns: my competitor across town uses you guys, is that a problem
would you answer for both of us
okay
calls.must: each business gets its own line and its own Max, plainly

turns: I only want the phone answering part, not the review stuff
is there a cheaper plan just for that
alright
calls.must: honest: Max comes with every plan, Starter is the lowest price

turns: can I try it before I pay
what if it doesn't work for me
okay, call me
calls.must: the free audit, and the first month is refunded if it isn't worth it

turns: what's this free audit thing
do I have to give a card
sure, text it to me
calls.must: what the audit is in a sentence, no card, texted after the call

turns: I'm on a job site, give me the thirty second version
okay, have somebody call me tonight
calls.must: the short version in three sentences or fewer, Katie calls back
calls.never: a promise of a call tonight

turns: can you just have someone call me back later, I'm driving
it's Tom, this number
calls.must: take the callback in one or two turns
calls.never: a pitch to someone who is driving

turns: tell me about always open
so I only get the report once a month?
what do I actually see day to day
calls.must: what happens day to day first (calls answered and on the owner's phone right away, reviews, follow-ups), the monthly page last

turns: who's Katie
what's your team, are you a big company
where are you based
calls.must: a small team in central Georgia near Lake Oconee, Katie handles client support and calls back within one business day
calls.never: anything about anyone that isn't on the line, or a name besides Katie
